title: 2026 Week 6 rushing offense six-metric equal-weight test
method: For each team, use arithmetic means of FBS-opponent game metrics through Week 6. Calculate 0–100 cross-team percentile for each source metric; composite of second-level and open-field percentiles; take exact equal mean of six metrics; add aggressive conference adjustment and original 0–12 point pregame opposing rush-defense top-30 premium (65% max, 35% mean). Stuff avoidance is already a higher-is-better negative rate. No manual team overrides.
limitations: Game-level equal weighting rather than rushing-play weighting; Week 1 included for metrics while opponent-premium data only Weeks 2–6.
Six metrics have equal weights in base; conference and opponent adjustments are additive external adjustments.
These source metrics may differ from user-reported season ranks due to timeframe, FBS-only scope, and data definitions.
Opponent premium rewards facing a top rushing defense irrespective of performance against it; predictive validation not yet performed.
